verdicts.explanation: All 9 noindexed pages sit under /rewards/ (staff benefits portal: MSF Staff Rewards, its Contacts and Principles and policies pages, plus AR/FR/ES translations), while the key public pages (home, who-we-are, contact-us, donation-plans, about-offices) carry no noindex.

The page's own text is 'Get in touch with your nearest MSF Office' and it is a directory of Operational Centres and Partner Sections (105 external links) rather than a single office's contact card, so it owes links to the right office, not its own phone/email.

evidence.value: Get in touch with your nearest MSF Office

verdicts.explanation: Both pages are live, real pages (not tests or placeholders) and their raw HTML has no viewport meta tag at all, so mobile visitors get the desktop-width layout on both.

The finding's own counts are a handful out of many on every page it lists: 12 of 253 controls on the homepage, 4 of 418 on who-we-are, 4 of 229 on the staff-rewards page - under 5% of controls on each page, not a pervasive labelling gap.

evidence.value: MSF - Médecins Sans Frontières | Medical humanitarian organisation

claims.title: /donation-plans has no plan names or amounts outside a third-party payments iframe
claims.why: The page's own text is 9 words ('See our plans above'); every plan name and donation amount lives inside an iframe on a different domain, which a non-rendering fetcher does not read, so the page has nothing to quote and a visitor whose browser blocks the frame sees a blank page.

suggested_action.summary: Render each plan's name and monthly amount as static HTML on donation-plans, alongside the payment iframe.
how: Add a plain-HTML list of plan names and amounts above or beside the iframe.
Keep the iframe only for the actual payment step.
suggested_action.verify: curl -s https://www.msf.org/donation-plans shows plan names and amounts in the HTML body, not just the iframe tag.

site_specific: Add a viewport meta tag setting width to device-width and initial-scale to 1 in the head of donation-plans.
Do the same on about-offices, the other page missing it.
Add a canonical link tag in the head of this page pointing to its own URL, donation-plans.
Add JSON-LD describing the donation plans (name and amount for each) once the plan text itself is rendered on the page, not only inside the payments iframe.

candidate_dispositions.claim_title: /donation-plans has no plan names or amounts outside a third-party payments iframe

candidate_dispositions.reason: The 'MSF' value on this page is the organisation's own standard abbreviation of 'Medecins Sans Frontieres (MSF) International', the value on the homepage, not a different or ambiguous brand name.
